content: Fodaši ãturore aram goijje
Ekdin dinor tinnwa baze munazator ṭaimot Fitor edde Yuhanna dórmogórot gil.
Heṛe mar feṛottu loti ãtur ekzon manušore hodun manuše bar gori ani dórmogóror šundor name dorozar hãse fotti din buwai dito, zene zara dórmogórot gole hitarattu hite horat sai fare.
Fitor edde Yuhanna dórmogórot goledde dekiyore he manušwaye hitarattu horat saiye.
Henot Fitore edde Yuhannaye šuza hitar mikka saiye. Bade Fitore hodde: "Ãrar mikka sa!"
Toi manušwaye hitarar hãsottu kissu faibar aša loi hitarar mikka sai roiye.
Toi Fitore hodde, "Rufa ba šuna ãttu nai, kintu za ase hin tore diyum: Nasarator Isa Mosir name uṛi tiya edde aṭ."
Bade Fitore hitar ḍen hat sai dori hitare tuille, henot hehon hitar ṭeng edde formuri sokto oiye.
Hite faldi uṛi ṭengor fatar uwore tiyaiye edde aṛa šuru goijje. Toi hite faldi faldi ãṛat maze Allare šukuriya guzar gori gori hitarar fũwati dórmogóror uṛanot giye.
Har mainše zehon hite aṛi faredde edde Allar tarif goredde deikke,
hẽtte hitara hitare sini faijje ze hite he manuš, ze dórmogóror šundor name dorozat boi horat magito. Ar hitar uwore ze hanḍo goiṭṭe hin deki hitara beša beši tajjuf edde ammuwak oiye.
He horat magoyawaye kintu Fitor edde Yuhannar fisa no sare. Fitoror he hamot hár manuš okkol tajjuf oiyore Soloimanor haissarar tole hitarare giri doijje.

Hetunot Fitore hodde: "Israili okkol! Tũwara iyanot tajjuf kiyolla or? Ãrar nizor šoktiye otóba Allare ḍorai de he gunor zoriya itare ãṛi faribolla šokti diyi mone gori kiyolla tũwara ãrar uzu sai taikko?

No, Ibrahim edde Isak edde Yakubor Allah, ãrar baf dadar Allaye ei hamor duwara hibar nizor gulam Isar mohima forhaš goijje. Tũwara to Isare mari felaibolla dori dila. Filate hibare eri dito sail, kintu tũwara Filator muntu hibare ošikar goijjo.
Tũwara he Fobitro edde Niyaiwalare ošikar gori ekzon kuni manušore tũwaralla eri dito hoiyo.
Ze zibon doya hibare tũwara mari felaila, kintu Allaye hibare zinda gori tuille, hiyanor goba ãra.

Ei manuš iba zare tũwara dekor edde zare tũwara sino, hite Isar namor gune he šokti hamaiye. Isar butottu di ze biššaš ãra fai hiyane ei manušware furafuri bafe aram goijje, zendilla tũwara beggune dekor.
"Ehon báiyain okkol, ãi zani tũwara tũwarar neta okkolor ḍoil no buziyore Isare kurušor uwore mari felaiyo.
Kintu Allaye hibar Mosiye ze duk šoibo he hota ei bafe furon goijje, ziyan hibaye bout age har nobi okkolor duwara howabail.
Hetolla, tũwara mon firo, toi tũwarar guna fũsi fela oibo.
Ar he Mosi zare tũwaralla basona gora oiye mani Isa, hibare defeṛaiyore tũwarare tottaza gori tuli fare.
Allaye hár kissure abar agor ḍoilla uwafes firai anibode hibar he ṭaim nuwaiye foijjonto hibattu behostot taka foribo, zendilla hibaye bout age hibar nobi okkolor muke hoil.
Musaye to hoiye, 'Mabud Allaye tũwaralla ãr ḍoilla ekzon nobi tũwarar nizor zatir butottu tulibo. Har kissu zin tũwarare hibaye ho hin beggun funa foribo.
Ze hibar hota no funibo hitare hibar mainšor butottu furafuri bafe fũsi fela oibo.'
"Hin bade o, nobi Samuelottu loti šuru gori har nobi okkol zara kalam hoi giye hitara o ei din okkolot zin goṭer hinor babute hoi giye.

Ar tũwara to he nobi okkolor bongšor manuš edde he wadar suktir šiyardar, ziyan Allaye tũwarar bafdada okkol loi goijjil, hẽtte Allaye Ibrahimore hoil, 'Tor bongšor butottu di duniyair har zatiye rahamot faibo.'
Allaye hibar gulam Isare tũwarar sarme tiya goraiye foila, hibare defeṛaiye, ze kufõtottu firi aiye hitare rahamot goribolla."
